title: Why Can Fashion Nostalgia Feel So Powerful?

sources.citation: Svoboda E, McKinnon MC, Levine B. The functional neuroanatomy of autobiographical memory: a meta-analysis. Neuropsychologia. 2006.
sources.limit: Distributed activation does not define a fashion-specific circuit.

sources.citation: Tulving E, Thomson DM. Encoding specificity and retrieval processes in episodic memory. Psychological Review. 1973.
sources.limit: Cue effectiveness does not guarantee accuracy or complete recall.

sources.citation: Holland AC, Kensinger EA. Emotion and autobiographical memory. Physics of Life Reviews. 2010.
sources.limit: Emotional vividness is not factual verification.

sources.citation: Janata P. The neural architecture of music-evoked autobiographical memories. Cerebral Cortex. 2009.
sources.limit: Music-evoked recall cannot establish a garment-specific mechanism.

sources.citation: Janata P, Tomic ST, Rakowski SK. Characterisation of music-evoked autobiographical memories. Memory. 2007.
sources.limit: Stimulus and sample conditions constrain generalization.

sources.citation: Herz RS, Schooler JW. A naturalistic study of autobiographical memories evoked by olfactory and visual cues. American Journal of Psychology. 2002.
sources.limit: Odor-evoked memory qualities do not establish accuracy.

sources.citation: Oba K et al. Memory and reward systems coproduce nostalgic experiences in the brain. Social Cognitive and Affective Neuroscience. 2016.
sources.limit: Small imaging sample; not a nostalgia center or treatment trial.

sources.citation: Yang Z et al. Patterns of brain activity associated with nostalgia. Scientific Reports. 2022.
sources.limit: Induction findings do not authenticate autobiographical events.

sources.citation: Wildschut T, Bruder M, Robertson S, van Tilburg WAP, Sedikides C. Collective nostalgia: a group-level emotion. Current Opinion in Psychology. 2018.
sources.limit: Group-level nostalgia is not individual autobiographical recall or historical proof.

sources.citation: Memory Garment Field Map, RN Collins, 2026.
sources.limit: Records experience; stores nothing; does not assess memory or cognition.
